svg.text: Radiation-phase molecular response predicts final TNT outcome in MSS LARC
Integrated WES + RNA-seq of 35 locally advanced rectal cancers (pre / post CRT biopsies) — Kim et al., 2026
35 MSS LARC · long-course CRT (50.4 Gy + capecitabine)
WES 77 · RNA-seq 56 · 49 PASS somatic VCFs · all MSS, TMB < 2/Mb
radiation phase induces sequential tumor clearance & immune reprogramming
9 independent nCRT rectal cohorts · N = 721 + Akiyoshi 2023 (N = 298)
actionable use of radiation-phase molecular response
CD8-cytotoxic · Treg · neoantigen Δ · mutation clearance
Take-home: Radiation-phase molecular response — mutation / neoantigen clearance and a reproducible CD8-cytotoxic axis —
defines a mid-treatment biomarker window to personalise consolidation chemotherapy in MSS locally advanced rectal cancer.
